Corporate Profile


華潤醫藥集團有限公司（股份代號：3320）是中                China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Limited (stock code: 3320) is a leading
國領先的綜合醫藥公司，業務範疇覆蓋醫藥及                   integrated pharmaceutical company in China. Our business encompasses
保 健 產 品 的 生 產、分 銷 及 零 售。本 集 團 成 立 於    manufacturing, distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and healthcare
二零零七年，現已發展成中國前五大醫藥製造                   products. Since the establishment in 2007, the Group has developed into one
商兼中國前三大醫藥產品分銷商（按收益）。                   of the fifth largest pharmaceutical manufacturers and one of the third largest
                                       pharmaceutical distributors (by revenue) in China.

發 售。我 們 的 製 造 業 務 涵 蓋 研 發、生 產 及 銷 售    Hong Kong. Our manufacturing business encompasses the research and
醫藥產品。我們生產 796 種藥品，產品組合包括               development, manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products. We
化學藥品、中藥、生物藥以及營養保健品，覆蓋                  manufacture 796 products comprising chemical drugs, Chinese medicines and
廣 泛 治 療 領 域，包 括 心 血 管、消 化 道 和 新 陳 代    biological drugs as well as nutritional and healthcare products, covering a

內部監控及風險管理                             INTERNAL CONTROL AND RISK MANAGEMENT
董事會明白，董事會須負責維持充分的風險管                  The Board acknowledges that it is the responsibility of the Board for
理及內部監控制度（該等風險包括（其中包括）與                maintaining an adequate risk management and internal control systems
本集團營運及重要環境、社會及管治相關的重                  (which cover, among others, significant risks concerning the Group’s
大風險），以保障股東的投資及本公司的資產，                 operations and material environmental, social and governance risks) to
並每年審閱該制度的有效性。風險管理及內部                  safeguard shareholder investments and Company assets and reviewing the
監控系統可對重大錯誤陳述或損失提供合理而                  effectiveness of such systems on an annual basis. The risk management and
非絕對的保證，並旨在管理而非消除在達致業                  internal control systems can provide reasonable and not absolute assurance
務目標的過程中出現的失敗風險。                       against material misstatement or loss and are designed to manage rather than
                                      eliminate the risk of failure in the process of attaining business objectives.

本集團已建立全面的風險管理及內部控制系統，                 The Group has established a comprehensive risk management and internal
並極為重視其製藥、醫藥分銷及藥品零售業務                  control system, and devoted significant attention to internal control measures
的內部控制措施。其已採取嚴格的內部控制措                  of its pharmaceutical manufacturing, pharmaceutical distribution and
施 及 經 營 程 式，以 監 管 從 研 發 到 生 產、分 銷 及   pharmaceutical retail businesses. It has adopted stringent internal control
零售的醫藥價值鏈各個環節。本集團內部控制                  measures and operating procedures to regulate all stages of its pharmaceutical
系統根據相關行業及管理標準（包括 GMP 及 GSP            value chain, from research and development to manufacturing, distribution
要求）設計。本集團定期實施內部控制審計、內                 and retail. The Group’s internal control system is designed according to
部風險管理及除錯防錯方面的各項程序。                    relevant industrial and management standards, including the GMP and GSP
                                      requirements. The Group implements the procedures for periodic internal
                                      control audit, internal risk management, and error correction and prevention
                                      on a regular basis.

有關發佈內幕消息方面，本公司已採納其《信息                 With respect to dissemination of inside information, the Company has
披露管理制度》，制定妥善的資訊披露流程。內                 adopted its “Information Disclosure Policy” setting out the procedures of
幕消息披露工作由董事會統一領導。未經授權，                 proper information disclosure. Release of inside information shall be led by
